run_render_one_block_change: run render_one_block_change.py with an npy schematic file and output directory to generate Minecraft render images
run_render_function: run the render function to launch Cuberite and generate vision and chunky images from a schematic
test_ray_intersect_triangle: test the ray_intersect_triangle function to check if a 3D ray intersects with a triangle
test_intersect_cube: test the intersect_cube function to check if a camera-to-focus ray intersects a cube
test_to_unit_vec: test the to_unit_vec function to convert yaw and pitch angles into a 3D unit vector
